from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out-4/play/users/u073/system/state/workspace/programs')

source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and grid[ny][nx] != 0 and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((ny,nx))
                        stack.append((ny,nx))
            r0 = min(y for y, x in cells)
            r1 = max(y for y, x in cells)
            c0 = min(x for y, x in cells)
            c1 = max(x for y, x in cells)
            depth_color = {}
            for y, x in cells:
                d = min(y-r0, r1-y, x-c0, c1-x)
                depth_color.setdefault(d, set()).add(grid[y][x])
            depths = sorted(depth_color)
            colors = [next(iter(depth_color[d])) for d in depths]
            reverse = dict(zip(depths, colors[::-1]))
            for y, x in cells:
                d = min(y-r0, r1-y, x-c0, c1-x)
                out[y][x] = reverse[d]
    return out
'''
